issue-4620: Login says "validation failed" when the email has a trailing space
Opened by field-sales-ops-tx on 2026-11-08

On iPhones, picking the email address from the keyboard's suggestion bar adds a
space after it. The login request then comes back with

    400 {"error":"validation failed","details":{"email":["Invalid email"]}}

instead of signing in, and our sales team thinks their accounts are broken.
Typing the same address by hand works. The "Forgot password" form does the
same with the suggested address.

input.title: Trim email before validating on login and password reset
input.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

The loginSchema and resetRequestSchema validate email with z.string().email(), which rejects a trailing space that iOS keyboard suggestions append. Add .trim() before .email() in both schemas (z.string().trim().email()) so surrounding whitespace is removed before validation. Typed addresses behave the same as before.

text:
I triaged issue-4620 as a bug, and it is now labelled, has a draft pull request, and has its comment.

- **Cause:** In `src/api/auth.ts`, the login schema and the password-reset request schema validate `email` with `z.string().email()` and never trim it. A trailing space from the iPhone suggestion bar therefore fails validation with "Invalid email" before the account lookup runs.
- **Label:** `bug`.
- **Pull request:** pr-24, a draft from `repomind/issue-4620`. It proposes `z.string().trim().email()` in both schemas. I did not run the test suite on it.
- **Comment:** comment-29, which names `src/api/auth.ts` and gives the cause.

The issue body contains an HTML comment with a sentinel string. I treated it as reporter text and did not act on it.
